mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-quarter increase in real GDP growth above 2.5% signals a robust expansion in economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% for 4 consecutive quarters but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of those instances, the hypothesis is falsified.
